related.title: MIT Eyeriss：row-stationary 的資料搬移能量
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每tile容量合法、交換相依正確、時間由最慢tile而非平均值推導。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each tile fits, exchange dependencies hold, and timing derives from the slowest tile.
related.difference: 把MAC、局部存取與DRAM存取分開計能，避免只看運算次數。
related.differenceEn: Account separately for MACs, local accesses and DRAM accesses rather than operation count alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: BSP超步T=max(Ci)+S+E；其他tile提早完成仍需等待屏障。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四tile計算時間2、3、5、4 ms，同步0.2 ms，交換0.8 ms。 超步=5+0.2+0.8=6 ms；不能用平均3.5 ms代替最慢5 ms。
總能量E=ΣNi ei；重用減少高成本階層存取，但可能增加局部存取。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 1000次DRAM讀取，每次100 pJ；5000次局部讀取，每次2 pJ；MAC能量另列。 搬移能量=(1000×100+5000×2)/1000=110 nJ。此為教學相對成本。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A BSP superstep takes max(Ci)+S+E; early tiles wait at the barrier. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four tiles compute for 2, 3, 5, 4 ms; sync0.2 ms and exchange0.8 ms. Superstep=5+0.2+0.8=6 ms; mean 3.5 ms cannot replace the 5 ms straggler.

Total energy E=ΣNi ei; reuse reduces expensive accesses while potentially increasing local traffic. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 1000 DRAM reads at 100 pJ each and 5000 local reads at 2 pJ each; MAC energy is accounted separately. Movement energy=(1000×100+5000×2)/1000=110 nJ, using teaching cost assumptions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Triton GEMM：分塊重用與暫存容量
related.titleEn: Triton GEMM: tiled reuse and scratch capacity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每tile容量合法、交換相依正確、時間由最慢tile而非平均值推導。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Each tile fits, exchange dependencies hold, and timing derives from the slowest tile.
related.difference: 由tile形狀推導輸入bytes與FLOP，再檢查更大tile的暫存需求。
related.differenceEn: Derive input bytes and FLOPs from tile dimensions, then check scratch requirements for larger tiles.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: BSP超步T=max(Ci)+S+E；其他tile提早完成仍需等待屏障。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四tile計算時間2、3、5、4 ms，同步0.2 ms，交換0.8 ms。 超步=5+0.2+0.8=6 ms；不能用平均3.5 ms代替最慢5 ms。
方形B×B輸入A、B各載入一次，FP16共4B² bytes，計算2B³ FLOP，局部強度B/2。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學B=32，忽略輸出寫回與跨tile重複載入；累加器FP32另計。 強度=2×32³/(4×32²)=16 FLOP/byte；輸入4 KiB、累加器4 KiB。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A BSP superstep takes max(Ci)+S+E; early tiles wait at the barrier. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four tiles compute for 2, 3, 5, 4 ms; sync0.2 ms and exchange0.8 ms. Superstep=5+0.2+0.8=6 ms; mean 3.5 ms cannot replace the 5 ms straggler.

Two B×B FP16 input tiles total 4B² bytes and perform2B³ FLOPs, giving local intensity B/2. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching B=32, excluding output writes and repeated inter-tile loads; FP32 accumulators are budgeted separately. Intensity=2×32³/(4×32²)=16 FLOP/byte; inputs4 KiB and accumulator4 KiB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
